'''Inflict Pain''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that required knowledge of the Control and Alter skills. A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] using Inflict Pain could cause their victim to experience great, incapacitating agony. The pain would continue for as long as the Force user maintained the power. If the target of the attack was also a Force user, they could used [[Control Pain]] to ignore the effects of the Force power.<ref name="RPG" />
